chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ibn al-Barqi, from his father, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl, from one who narrated to him, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

There are ten places in which one does not perform salat (prayer): mud, water, the bathhouse, graves, the beaten parts of the road, ant colonies, the resting places of camels, the course of water, saline ground, and snow.

key_terms.مَجْرَى الْمَاءِ: the course or flow-channel of water
key_terms.مَعَاطِنُ الْإِبِلِ: the resting places or watering places of camels

ai.seo_question: In which places is salat (prayer) prohibited or disallowed according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith lists ten places in which salat (prayer) is not to be performed. It is a jurisprudential narration concerning the proper locations for prayer and the avoidance of unsuitable or impure places.
